description: Defines classes and structures related to transaction state management in Android's surfaceflinger, including ResolvedComposerState and TransactionState, with methods for traversing buffer states and checking frame activity.

classes.name: ResolvedComposerState
classes.description: Extends ComposerState by including external texture and various ID fields for buffer resolution.

classes.name: TransactionState
classes.description: Holds information about a surface transaction, including composer states, display states, and methods for traversing buffer states.

methods.name: traverseStatesWithBuffers
methods.description: Visits each buffer state with a provided visitor function, applying it to states with buffer changes and valid external textures.

methods.name: traverseStatesWithBuffersWhileTrue
methods.description: Iterates over buffer states, applying a visitor that can control traversal or delete states.

methods.name: isFrameActive
methods.description: Determines if the current transaction involves an active frame based on display and layer states.
